## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace` pass locally
- [ ] New behaviour has tests; bug fixes include a regression test
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or customer document content in the diff
- [ ] Security-relevant changes are described against `docs/security/THREAT-MODEL.md`
- [ ] Commit subjects follow Conventional Commits and I agree to the [DCO](CONTRIBUTING.md#developer-certificate-of-origin)
